feedback_history.therapist_response:
I don’t know how to start, honestly. It feels like everything’s just… floating. Like I’m underwater and I can’t remember how to swim. I keep thinking about how much I want to help animals or people—maybe even be a doctor—but it feels like I’m already broken, and no matter what I do, I’m just gonna keep falling behind.  

I don’t know if I’m even capable of trying anymore. I’ve lost so many people, and I feel like I don’t deserve to be part of anything real. I just… sit here and watch the world move and feel like I’m standing still. I don’t even know if I’m supposed to be here.  

What if I’m not meant to be okay? What if I just… stay like this?  

I guess I’m here because I need to feel seen. Not fixed. Just… seen.
